models.name: TimeMixer

models.venue_status: ICLR2024 verified in author README citation
models.doi_kind: arXiv full-paper DOI, not an ICLR editorial DOI

flow: Observed X and valid downsampled scales
Fine-to-coarse season and coarse-to-fine trend MLP mixing
equations: S_l <- S_l + MLP_down(S_(l-1)); T_l <- T_l + MLP_up(T_(l+1))
models.complexity: Own estimate sums dense temporal mixing costs across scales L_l; O(sum_l C L_l² + feature-FFN costs). No measured FLOP claim.

models.risk: Do not use defaults for histories96/336 blindly; no extra future time features or unchanged channelwise inverse scaling for a different target.

models.name: TimesNet
models.paper_title: TimesNet: Temporal 2D-Variation Modeling for General Time Series Analysis
models.venue_status: ICLR2023 verified in author README citation
models.identifier_evidence: Author README links arXiv:2210.02186; exact DOI resolver not accessed
flow: Inception2D convolution and weighted residual fusion
equations: p_i = floor(L/f_i), f_i in selected nonzero FFT bins
models.complexity: Own estimate O(L d log L) for FFT plus O(sum_i A_i k_i² d_in d_out) for 2D convolutions over padded grids. No numerical FLOP measurement.
models.adaptation: D7 admits only a few positive FFT bins; constrain top_k and exclude DC explicitly, with a defined tie/constant-signal case. Do not infer long market cycles from seven days. Use scalar head before channelwise inverse scaling.
models.risk: Official TimesNet README moved executable source to official Time-Series-Library; record both repositories. FFT selection depends on input; periods beyond observed support are not evidence of learned long memory.

models.name: Autoformer
models.paper_title: Autoformer: Decomposition Transformers with Auto-Correlation for Long-Term Series Forecasting
models.venue_status: NeurIPS2021 verified in author README citation
flow: Auto-Correlation blocks over latent seasonal signal
equations: AC(Q,K,V) = sum_(tau in selected_lags) softmax(R_QK(tau)) roll(V,tau)
models.complexity: FFT-based correlation component O(L d log L) plus projections/FFNs O(L d²). Own structural summary, not a measured full-model cost.
models.adaptation: Short odd moving-average kernel≤7, no future true values/calendar extras. Original trend addition is in input-variable units: it cannot be added unchanged to scalar sigma7. Register a coherent learned scalar projection before channelwise inverse normalization.
models.risk: Simply setting c_out=1 can broadcast an OHLCV trend into wrong target units. A covariate-only volatility regressor is an explicit adaptation, not the unmodified original forecaster.

models.complexity: Own estimate O(C L d + C² d + C d²) per embedding/block, attention across C variables rather than L time points.

models.name: S-Mamba
models.paper_title: Is Mamba effective for time series forecasting?
models.venue_status: Neurocomputing publication2025 per supplied WoS record, early accessDEC2024; author README BibTeX uses2024
models.identifier_evidence: Native WoS UT WOS:001416250600001 DI field and author README Neurocomputing article129178; arXiv:2403.11144

flow: Seven historical values per each of five variates
Forward and reversed Mamba scans across observed variates
FFN residuals and scalar target head
equations: s_i = Abar_i s_(i-1)+Bbar_i x_i; z_i=C_i s_i [selective SSM schematic]
models.complexity: Own axis-aware summary: history embedding O(C L d); selective scan linear in C variate tokens for fixed state/width, plus FFN/projection costs. This implementation does not simply scan L chronological tokens.
models.adaptation: Bidirectionality is over already observed variate tokens, not future dates. Scalar head before input-channel de-normalization. Source imports mamba_ssm; CPU/hardware-compatible reference implementation and equivalence must be checked before benchmark.
models.risk: License not verified. model/S_Mamba.py docstring incorrectly links iTransformer by copy; use README and WoS identity. EncoderLayer registers unused man/man2/attention modules: naive parameter counts include inactive modules. Define counting/implementation policy explicitly, without importing unexplained extras.
